abstract.cn: 想象一个人的工作分成几项技能，一扇门关上并不终结整个职业。

examples.en: Farmers were advised to diversify their crops after the drought.
examples.cn: 干旱之后，农民被建议使作物多样化。

examples.en: The fund diversifies across regions and industries.
examples.cn: 该基金在地域与行业上分散投资。

examples.en: The city hopes to diversify away from tourism.
examples.cn: 这座城市希望摆脱对旅游业的依赖而走向多元化。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「使分成许多样」——把投资、产品、作物都分成好几路 → 多元化

root: 由拉丁语 diversus「转向别处的、多样的」与 facere「制造」构成，经法语进入英语；核心动作是使一类事物变成多类。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses apply one act to different objects: reading lists, portfolios, business lines, markets, regional economies, genes, careers, crops and energy sources.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项把同一个动作用到不同对象上：书单、投资组合、业务线、市场、地区经济、基因、职业、作物与能源来源。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one hand scattering the same seed across several fields.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手把同一种种子撒向好几块田。

branches.en: GENERAL ACTION: a single range is deliberately widened into several kinds.
branches.cn: 一般动作：单一范围被有意拓宽成好几种。

branches.en: FINANCIAL ACTION: money is placed in many assets instead of one.
branches.cn: 金融动作：资金被放进多项资产而不是只有一项。

branches.en: NEW WORK: a firm adds business lines and a person adds kinds of practice.
branches.cn: 新工作：公司增添业务线，个人增添业务种类。

branches.en: WIDENING MIX: products, regional industries and supply sources are all re-mixed.
branches.cn: 拓宽组合：产品、地区产业与供应来源都被重新调配。

branches.en: NATURAL AND FIELD VARIETY: genes and crops are varied so one disease cannot take everything.
branches.cn: 自然与田地的多样：基因与作物被多样化，使一种病害拿不走全部。

intro.en: Diversify is a transparent Latin-derived verb: a turning root, a making suffix, and a family of related nouns and adjectives.
intro.cn: diversify 是一个结构清楚的拉丁来源动词：一个「转」的词根、一个「制造」的后缀，以及一族相关名词与形容词。

latinIntro.en: The root vertere 'to turn' also builds convert, reverse and versatile; diversus adds the sense of turning apart.
latinIntro.cn: 词根表示「转」，也构成 convert、reverse 与 versatile；diversus 增添「转向别处」的意思。

items.example: The root appears in reverse and version.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根出现在反转与版本等词里。

items.example: To clarify is to make clear.

items.meaning: made varied, or having entered new lines
items.meaningCN: 已多样化的，或已进入新业务线的
items.example: The economy is more diversified now.

items.exampleCN: 他们正在使供应商多样化。
他们服务于一个多元市场。

items.meaning: a person or thing that diversifies
items.meaningCN: 进行多样化的人或事物
items.exampleCN: 黄金充当一种分散工具。

latinEntries.meaning: able to turn to many uses

derivatives.zh: 分散风险者；多元化经营者

definition_zh: 生态系统多样性；一个区域内生态系统类型及其内部组合的多样性
definition_en: the variety of ecosystem types in an area and of the communities and physical settings that make each of them up
core_image: 同一片山地并排着三种地面：针叶林、泥炭沼泽与碎石草甸，交界处各自伸出不同的植物
scene: 测绘员在同一条山脊上标出森林、沼泽与草甸的边界，三块地彼此相邻却各有一套物种。 The map records the ecosystem diversity of the whole catchment.
sceneCN: 这里指一个区域内生态系统类型及其组合的多样程度（第 1 个义项：生态系统类型的多样性）；句意为这张图记录了整个流域的生态系统多样性。

pos.zh: 生态系统多样性（不可数短语名词）
生态系统层次上的多样性（生物多样性三层次之一）

collocations.zh: 生态系统多样性的丧失
某区域的生态系统多样性

derivatives.zh: 该短语的限定词，由希腊语表示「家宅」的词与表示「组合整体」的词构成，义为「生态系统」
由该名词加形容词词尾构成，义为「生态系统的；系统层面的」
该短语的核心词，由拉丁语表示「转向不同方向」的词而来，义为「多样的」
由表示「多样」的形容词加表示性质的名词词尾构成，义为「多样性」
由表示「多样」的形容词加动词词尾构成，义为「使多样化」
由表示「农田」的成分加该名词构成，义为「农业生态系统」

senses.title: Variety of ecosystem types
senses.titleCN: 生态系统类型的多样性
senses.definition: the number and range of ecosystem types, such as forest, marsh, lake and grassland, present in an area
senses.definitionCN: 一个地区内森林、沼泽、湖泊、草原等生态系统类型的数量与种类跨度
senses.example: Ecosystem diversity falls sharply when the marsh and the dry meadow are both replaced by one plantation.
senses.exampleCN: 当沼泽与干草甸都被同一片人工林取代时，生态系统多样性会急剧下降。
senses.why: Diversity at this level counts whole systems, so the unit is a type of place rather than an organism.
senses.whyCN: 这一层的多样性以整个系统计数，因此单位是一类地方，而不是一个生物。

senses.title: Variety inside one ecosystem
senses.titleCN: 单一生态系统内部的组合差异
senses.definition: the range of communities, substrates and water conditions contained within a single ecosystem
senses.definitionCN: 一个生态系统内部所包含的群落、基底与水文条件的多样程度
senses.example: A large floodplain shows high ecosystem diversity even though it counts as one ecosystem type.
senses.exampleCN: 一片大河漫滩虽然只算一个生态系统类型，却表现出很高的内部组合多样性。
senses.why: One system still holds many patches, and the phrase covers that interior variety as well.
senses.whyCN: 一个系统内部仍有许多斑块，这个短语也涵盖这种内部的差异。

senses.title: One of the three levels of biodiversity
senses.titleCN: 生物多样性三个层次之一
senses.definition: the ecosystem level in the standard three-part account of biological diversity, alongside genes and species
senses.definitionCN: 在通行的生物多样性三层次划分中，与基因、物种并列的生态系统那一层
senses.example: Reports on biological diversity usually treat ecosystem diversity as a separate chapter.
senses.exampleCN: 关于生物多样性的报告通常把生态系统多样性单列一章。
senses.why: The three-level scheme was built for measurement, so each layer needed its own name.
senses.whyCN: 三层次框架是为度量而建的，因此每一层都需要自己的名称。

senses.title: Landscape-scale pattern
senses.titleCN: 景观尺度的格局多样性
senses.definition: the spatial arrangement and patchiness of ecosystems across a landscape
senses.definitionCN: 生态系统在景观上的空间排布与斑块化程度
senses.example: Satellite images show the ecosystem diversity of the delta as a shifting patchwork.
senses.exampleCN: 卫星影像显示，这片三角洲的生态系统多样性是一片不断变化的镶嵌格局。
senses.why: Arrangement matters as much as number, which is why mapping became the standard method.
senses.whyCN: 排布与数量同样重要，所以制图成了标准方法。

senses.title: A classified and mapped quantity
senses.definition: a figure produced by classifying land cover into ecosystem units and summing their extent
senses.definitionCN: 把地表覆盖划分为生态系统单元、再统计其范围所得出的数值
senses.example: The survey reported ecosystem diversity per square kilometre of the catchment.
senses.exampleCN: 调查按流域每平方公里报告了生态系统多样性。
senses.why: Classification rules decide the number, so the phrase often means the output of a map rather than a fact in the field.
senses.whyCN: 分类规则决定了数目，因此这个短语常指一张图的产出，而不是野外的直接事实。

senses.title: Variety of ecosystem processes
senses.titleCN: 生态系统过程的多样性
senses.definition: the range of processes, such as flooding, fire and nutrient cycling, that different systems perform
senses.definitionCN: 不同系统所执行的洪水、火烧、养分循环等过程的多样程度
senses.example: Fire-prone grassland and waterlogged fen add a process dimension to ecosystem diversity.
senses.exampleCN: 易火的草原与常年积水的沼泽为生态系统多样性增加了一层过程维度。
senses.why: Two systems with similar species can still work differently, so the term widened from parts to operations.
senses.whyCN: 两个物种相近的系统仍可能以不同方式运转，因此这个术语从「部件」扩展到了「操作」。

senses.title: A spatial unit for conservation planning
senses.titleCN: 保护规划中的空间单元
senses.definition: the set of ecosystem types used to select reserves and set representation targets
senses.definitionCN: 用来选择保护地、设定代表性目标的那一组生态系统类型
senses.example: Planners asked which ecosystem diversity the network still fails to represent.
senses.exampleCN: 规划者追问，这个保护网络仍然没有代表哪些生态系统多样性。
senses.why: Conservation works by types of place, so this level became the currency of reserve design.
senses.whyCN: 保护工作按地方的类型来做，这一层于是成了保护地设计的通用货币。

senses.title: An indicator of resilience
senses.titleCN: 恢复力与稳定性的指标
senses.definition: a measure of how many alternative systems a landscape can draw on when conditions change
senses.definitionCN: 衡量景观在条件变化时能调用的替代系统有多少的指标
senses.example: A landscape with high ecosystem diversity is less likely to lose all production in one drought.
senses.exampleCN: 生态系统多样性高的景观，在一次干旱中失去全部产出的可能性更小。
senses.why: Where one system fails another can take over, so variety at this level is read as insurance.
senses.whyCN: 一个系统失灵时另一个可以接手，因此这一层的多样性被读作保险。

senses.title: The contrast with species diversity
senses.definition: a level distinguished from species counts because a species-rich site can still hold only one system
senses.definitionCN: 与物种计数相区别的层次，因为物种丰富的地点也可能只有一种系统
senses.example: Two sites with equal species lists can differ widely in ecosystem diversity.
senses.exampleCN: 两份物种名单相同的地点，可能在生态系统多样性上差别很大。
senses.why: Counts of organisms and counts of systems answer different questions, so the term is defined partly by what it excludes.
senses.whyCN: 数生物与数系统回答的是不同问题，因此这个术语有一部分是靠排除来定义的。

intro.en: The phrase joins a term coined in nineteen thirty-five from two Greek words with a Latin word for variety. It is a twentieth-century scientific compound with a traceable author.
intro.cn: 这个短语把一九三五年用两个希腊词造成的一个术语，与一个表示「多样」的拉丁词合在一起，是作者可考的二十世纪科学复合词。

items.en: Oikos meant house or household, and it supplied the idea of the whole place where life is carried on.
items.cn: 这个词意为房屋或家户，提供了「生命在其中展开的整个场所」这一想法。

items.en: Systema meant an organized whole made of parts, from the verb to set together.
items.cn: 这个词意为由各部分组成的有机整体，出自「放在一起」这一动词。

items.en: The botanist Arthur Tansley coined ecosystem to name the organisms and their physical setting as one unit.
items.cn: 植物学家坦斯利造出表示「新系统」的新词，把生物与其物理环境视为一个单位。

items.en: Divertere meant to turn apart, and its participle described things drawn in different directions.
items.cn: 这个词意为转开，其分词形式描述被拉向不同方向的事物。

items.en: Diversitas named difference and variety, and English diversity came through French.
items.cn: 这个词表示差异与多样，英语中表示「多样性」的名词经法语而来。

items.en: Ecologists later put the coined unit in front of the borrowed noun to name the ecosystem level of variety; the exact first use is dated only approximately.
items.cn: 生态学家后来把这个新造的单位放在借来的名词前面，用以命名多样性中的生态系统层次；确切首见年代只能给约数。

note.en: The first group shares ecosystem or diversity; the second group names the other levels and close measures of variety.
note.cn: 第一组共用 ecosystem 或 diversity；第二组是多样性的其他层次与相邻度量。

entries.definition: Organisms plus their physical surroundings treated as one working unit.
entries.definitionCN: 指生物加上其物理环境，被视为一个运转的单位。

entries.definition: The study of those units and their relations; it shares the house element, not the system element.
entries.definitionCN: 指对这些单位及其关系的研究；共用一个「家宅」成分，不含「系统」成分。

entries.definition: The state of being varied, the core noun of the phrase.
entries.definitionCN: 指多样的状态，是本短语的核心名词。

entries.definition: Of several different kinds.
entries.definitionCN: 指包含多种不同种类。

entries.definition: Household management; it shares the house element but belongs to a different stem.
entries.definitionCN: 指家政管理；共用一个「家宅」成分，但属于另一词干。

entries.definition: The umbrella term covering genes, species and ecosystems together.
entries.definitionCN: 指把基因、物种与生态系统一并涵盖的总称。

entries.definition: Variety measured at the level of species rather than systems.
entries.definitionCN: 指在物种层次而非系统层次度量的多样性。

entries.definition: The range of habitat patches, often counted within one ecosystem.
entries.definitionCN: 指生境斑块的多样程度，常在一个生态系统内计数。

entries.definition: The mixedness of a landscape, a spatial cousin of the term.
entries.definitionCN: 指景观的混合程度，是这个术语在空间上的近亲。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the coinage date, the two Greek parts and the three-level scheme.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用造词年代、两个希腊成分与三层次框架。

normal.en: Oikos is house and systema is a set of parts, so an ecosystem is a household of parts.
normal.cn: 前半是「家宅」，后半是「部件的组合」，所以生态系统就是一堆部件组成的家。

normal.en: Tansley coined the word in nineteen thirty-five, which makes it younger than the telephone.
normal.cn: 坦斯利在一九三五年造出这个词，它比电话还年轻。

normal.en: The three levels are genes, species and ecosystems, and this phrase names the third.
normal.cn: 三个层次是基因、物种与生态系统，这个短语命名的正是第三层。

normal.en: Two sites can share a species list and still differ here, because the list is not the map.
normal.cn: 两个地点可以物种名单相同，在这一层却不同，因为名单不是地图。

normal.en: Mapping is the usual method, since a type of place has to be drawn before it can be counted.
normal.cn: 常用方法是制图，因为一类地方要先画出来才能计数。

abstract.en: Ecosystem diversity is variety of arrangements, not variety of parts: the same species can be organised into different wholes.
abstract.cn: 生态系统多样性是排布方式的多样，而不是部件的多样：同样的物种可以被组织成不同的整体。

abstract.en: A landscape keeps several ways of working alive at once, and that redundancy is its insurance.
abstract.cn: 一片景观同时让几种运转方式活着，这种冗余就是它的保险。

abstract.en: Counting systems rather than organisms moves the eye from actors to stages.
abstract.cn: 数系统而不是数生物，视线就从演员移到了舞台。

examples.en: Ecosystem diversity in the delta depends on keeping both fresh and salt marsh.
examples.cn: 三角洲的生态系统多样性取决于淡水沼泽与盐沼都被保留下来。

examples.en: The assessment ranked ecosystem diversity above species counts for reserve selection.
examples.cn: 这项评估在选择保护地时把生态系统多样性排在物种计数之前。

examples.en: Planting a single tree species across the plain reduced ecosystem diversity sharply.
examples.cn: 在平原上遍植单一树种，使生态系统多样性急剧下降。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读作「伊扣西斯特姆 戴维西提」——伊扣是家，西斯特姆是部件组合，一个家加上许多套部件组合，就是生态系统多样性

root: 希腊语 oikos「家宅」+ 希腊语 systema「由部分组成的整体」→ 英语中表示「生态系统」的新词，一九三五年由坦斯利造出；拉丁语 diversus「被转向不同方向」← divertere ← vertere「转动」→ 表示「多样性」的名词。两词在二十世纪合为固定短语，确切首见年代只能给约数。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses count whole systems, then open them up: interior patchwork, the three-level scheme, landscape pattern, mapping, processes, reserve design and resilience.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项先以整个系统计数，再逐层展开：内部镶嵌、三层次框架、景观格局、制图、过程、保护地设计与恢复力。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: three ground types meet along one ridge, each carrying its own set of plants.
core.cn: 核心意象：三类地面在同一条山脊上相接，各自带着一套植物。

branches.en: THE UNIT AND ITS CONTRAST: whole system types, defined partly against species counts.
branches.cn: 单位与对照：整个系统的类型，部分靠与物种计数相区别来定义。

branches.en: THE INTERIOR: communities and substrates packed inside one system.
branches.cn: 内部：一个系统内部紧密排布的群落与基底。

branches.en: THE SCHEME: the ecosystem layer of the three-level account of biological diversity.
branches.cn: 框架：生物多样性三层次中的生态系统那一层。

branches.en: THE MAP: spatial arrangement, and the classified extent that a survey reports.
branches.cn: 地图：空间排布，以及调查报告的分类面积。

branches.en: THE WORK: processes performed, units used in reserve design, and the insurance value of alternatives.
branches.cn: 运转：所执行的过程、用于保护地设计的单元，以及替代方案的保险价值。

intro.en: A Greek house word and a Greek whole word make the unit; a Latin turning word makes the variety.
intro.cn: 一个希腊语「家宅」词和一个希腊语「整体」词构成单位，一个拉丁语「转向」词构成多样性。

latinIntro.en: The first element is Greek, so the Latin entries belong to the variety half only.
latinIntro.cn: 前半是希腊语，因此拉丁语词条只属于「多样性」那一半。

items.example: It marks the whole place where life is carried on.
items.exampleCN: 它标记生命在其中展开的整个场所。

items.example: It marks the unit as a working whole.
items.exampleCN: 它标记这个单位是一个运转的整体。

items.example: It forms the adjective of the unit.
items.exampleCN: 它构成该单位的形容词。

items.example: It carries separation inside the word.
The same stem gives convert and reverse.
items.exampleCN: 同一词干还给出「转换」与「反转」。

items.example: It makes the abstract noun of variety.
items.exampleCN: 它构成表示多样的抽象名词。

items.example: It is the recorded Greek source of the first element.
items.exampleCN: 它是有记录的、第一成分的希腊语来源。

items.example: It is the recorded Greek source of the second element.
items.exampleCN: 它是有记录的、第二成分的希腊语来源。

derivatives.zh: 由希腊语两个成分构成，义为「生态系统」
由该名词加形容词词尾构成，义为「生态系统层面的」
由表示「农田」的成分加该名词构成，义为「农业生态系统」
由核心形容词加动词词尾构成，义为「使多样化」

definition_zh: n. 清洁剂；洗涤剂 adj. 去污的；洗涤的
definition_en: a substance used with water to clean clothes or dishes, or having the power to lift dirt from a surface
core_image: 一滴洗洁精落进油碗，油膜向四周散开；洗衣机滚筒里泡沫翻起，衣物变干净
scene: 这种洗涤剂能去掉油渍。 This detergent removes grease.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：detergent 指洗涤剂；句意是这种洗涤剂能去掉油渍。

pos.zh: 清洁剂；洗涤剂
去污的；洗涤的

senses.title: A washing substance
senses.definition: a substance used with water to clean clothes or dishes
senses.definitionCN: 与水一起用来清洗衣物或餐具的物质
senses.example: This detergent removes grease.
senses.exampleCN: 这种洗涤剂能去掉油渍。
senses.why: A drop falling into an oily bowl and pushing the film apart.
senses.whyCN: 一滴落进油碗、把油膜推开的液体。

senses.title: A cleaning power
senses.definition: the ability of a liquid to lift dirt from a surface
senses.definitionCN: 液体把污垢从表面带走的能力
senses.example: The detergent action lifts the stain.
senses.exampleCN: 这种去污作用把污渍带了起来。
senses.why: A stain lifting off a plate under foam.
senses.whyCN: 泡沫下一块正从盘子上脱落的污渍。

senses.title: A class of products
senses.definition: a type of cleaning product sold for a particular use
senses.definitionCN: 为某种用途出售的一类清洁产品
senses.example: They compared three laundry detergents.
senses.exampleCN: 他们比较了三种洗衣洗涤剂。
senses.why: Three bottles lined up on a shop shelf.
senses.whyCN: 商店货架上并排的三瓶清洁剂。

intro.en: Detergent comes from Latin detergere, de- away plus tergere to wipe or cleanse; it is not related to deter, which comes from terrere, to frighten.
intro.cn: detergent 源自拉丁语 detergere，由 de-（去掉）加 tergere（擦拭、洗净）构成；它与 deter 无关，deter 来自 terrere（使害怕）。

items.en: Tergere meant to wipe or cleanse.
items.cn: tergere 意为擦拭、洗净。

items.en: Detergere meant to wipe away.
items.cn: detergere 意为擦掉、洗净。

items.en: Detergens was the present participle, wiping away.
items.cn: detergens 是现在分词，意为正在擦去的。

items.en: Detergent first described a cleansing medicine.
items.cn: 十七世纪 detergent 先指有清洁作用的药物。

items.en: It became the name for synthetic washing powders.
items.cn: 二十世纪它成为合成洗衣粉的名称。

items.en: Detergent now covers liquids and pods.
items.cn: 如今 detergent 涵盖洗衣液与凝珠。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the terg- wipe family and warns that deter is a different root; the near-meaning group names other cleaning substances.
note.cn: 形近组共享 terg-（擦拭）家族，并提醒 deter 是另一个词根；近义组是其他清洁用品。

entries.definition: To cleanse by wiping; it shares tergere and is the verb behind the noun.
entries.definitionCN: 擦拭洁净；共享 tergere，是这个名词背后的动词。

entries.definition: Using few words; it comes from tersus, wiped clean, so language with nothing extra.
entries.definitionCN: 用词简短的；来自 tersus（擦干净的），指没有多余成分的语言。

entries.definition: To frighten away; it looks similar but comes from terrere, not tergere.
entries.definitionCN: 吓退；形似但来自 terrere，而非 tergere。

entries.definition: A substance made from fat and alkali for washing.
entries.definitionCN: 由油脂与碱制成、用于洗涤的物质。

entries.definition: A substance used for cleaning skin or surfaces.
entries.definitionCN: 用于清洁皮肤或表面的物质。

entries.definition: A liquid that dissolves another substance.
entries.definitionCN: 能溶解其他物质的液体。

normalIntro.en: Detergent is de- away plus terg- wipe: wipe the dirt away with water.
normalIntro.cn: detergent 就是 de-（去掉）加 terg-（擦拭）：用水把污垢擦走。

normal.en: Terg- means wipe, not frighten.
normal.cn: terg- 意为擦拭，不是使害怕。

normal.en: Deter and detergent are unrelated.
normal.cn: deter 与 detergent 并不同源。

normal.en: Terse shares the wiped clean root.
normal.cn: terse 共享「擦干净」这个词根。

normal.en: Laundry detergent washes clothes.
normal.cn: laundry detergent 洗衣服。

normal.en: Detergent can also be an adjective.
normal.cn: detergent 也可以作形容词。

abstract.en: A drop falling into an oily bowl and pushing the film apart.
abstract.cn: 一滴落进油碗、把油膜推开的液体。

abstract.en: A stain lifting off a plate under foam.
abstract.cn: 泡沫下一块正从盘子上脱落的污渍。

abstract.en: Three bottles lined up on a shop shelf.
abstract.cn: 商店货架上并排的三瓶清洁剂。

examples.en: Add a little detergent to the warm water.
examples.cn: 往温水里加一点洗涤剂。

examples.en: These detergents are safe for colours.
examples.cn: 这些洗涤剂对彩色衣物安全。

examples.en: Rinse off the detergent residue.
examples.cn: 把洗涤剂残留冲掉。

dict_mnemonic.text: detergent ＝ de（去掉）＋ terg（擦拭，拉丁语 tergere；terse「擦干净的→简洁的」同根）＋ -ent（…的物）＝把污垢擦掉的东西，「洗涤剂」。注意与 deter（terrere 使害怕）不同源。

root: 拉丁语 tergere（擦拭、洗净）→ de-＋tergere → detergere → 现在分词 detergens → 英语 detergent

sensesIntro.en: One bowl of oily water: a drop, a lifted stain and three bottles on a shelf.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一碗油水：一滴液体、一块被带起的污渍与货架上的三瓶清洁剂。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a drop falling into an oily bowl and pushing the grease film apart
core.cn: 核心意象：一滴落进油碗、把油膜向四周推开的液体

branches.en: A drop falling into an oily bowl and pushing the film apart.
branches.cn: 一滴落进油碗、把油膜推开的液体。

branches.en: A stain lifting off a plate under foam.
branches.cn: 泡沫下一块正从盘子上脱落的污渍。

branches.en: Three bottles lined up on a shop shelf.
branches.cn: 商店货架上并排的三瓶清洁剂。

branches.en: Both lift dirt off a surface.
branches.cn: 两者都把污垢从表面带走。

branches.en: Both name what does the cleaning.
branches.cn: 两者都指起清洁作用的东西。

intro.en: Detergent is de- plus terg- plus -ent; the wipe root also gives terse and abstergent.
intro.cn: detergent 由 de- 加 terg- 加 -ent 构成；擦拭这个词根也给出 terse 与 abstergent。

latinIntro.en: Latin tergere means to wipe, tersus wiped clean and solvere to loosen.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 tergere 意为擦拭，tersus 意为擦干净的，solvere 意为松开。

definition_zh: v. 放掉…的气；使瘪下去；使泄气、挫伤（信心）；紧缩（通货）
definition_en: to let air or gas out of something, or to make someone feel less confident or proud
core_image: 一个鼓鼓的气球被松开嘴，气嘶嘶往外跑，皮慢慢皱下去
scene: 他给轮胎放了气。 He deflated the tyre slowly.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：deflate 指放掉气体；句意是他慢慢给轮胎放了气。

pos.zh: 放掉…的气；使瘪下去；使泄气；紧缩（通货）

senses.title: Let air out
senses.definition: to let air or gas out of something
senses.definitionCN: 把某物里的气放出来
senses.example: He deflated the tyre slowly.
senses.exampleCN: 他慢慢给轮胎放了气。
senses.why: A tight skin loosening as the breath leaves.
senses.whyCN: 气一走，绷紧的皮就松了。

senses.title: Make someone less confident
senses.definition: to make someone feel less proud or confident
senses.definitionCN: 让某人不再那么自负或有信心
senses.example: The result deflated the whole team.
senses.exampleCN: 这个结果让全队泄了气。
senses.why: A balloon of pride pricked by one fact.
senses.whyCN: 一个骄傲的气球被一个事实戳破。

senses.title: Reduce prices and money supply
senses.definition: to reduce the amount of money in an economy
senses.definitionCN: 减少经济中的货币量
senses.example: The government tried to deflate the economy.
senses.exampleCN: 政府试图紧缩经济。
senses.why: Air let out of a swollen market.
senses.whyCN: 把膨胀市场里的气放掉。

senses.title: Show a claim to be weak
senses.definition: to show that an argument or claim is weak
senses.definitionCN: 指出某个论点或说法站不住脚
senses.example: She deflated his argument in one line.
senses.exampleCN: 她一句话就驳倒了他的论点。
senses.why: A big shape made small by a pin.
senses.whyCN: 一个大形状被一根针缩小。

intro.en: Deflate is de- plus flare, to blow, on the pattern of inflate.
intro.cn: deflate 由 de- 加 flare（吹）构成，仿照 inflate 的模式。

items.en: Flare meant to blow.
items.cn: flare 意为吹。

items.en: Inflare meant to blow into.
items.cn: inflare 意为吹进去。

items.en: Inflate entered English for filling with air.
items.cn: 十八世纪 inflate 以充气义进入英语。

items.en: Deflate was formed as the opposite of inflate.
items.cn: 十九世纪 deflate 作为 inflate 的反义词构成。

items.en: Deflate gained the economic sense of reducing money.
items.cn: 二十世纪 deflate 带上减少货币的经济含义。

items.en: Deflate is also used for wounded pride.
items.cn: 如今 deflate 也用于受挫的自尊。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the flat- blowing family; the near-meaning group names letting down or shrinking.
note.cn: 形近组共享 flat-（吹）家族；近义组都是「放掉、缩小」的说法。

entries.definition: To fill something with air or gas.
entries.definitionCN: 充气；夸大。

entries.definition: A general fall in the level of prices.
entries.definitionCN: 通货紧缩。

entries.definition: To make something change direction.
entries.definitionCN: 使偏斜。

entries.definition: To become smaller in size.
entries.definitionCN: 收缩。

entries.definition: To make a small hole in something.
entries.definitionCN: 刺破。

entries.definition: To make someone less confident or hopeful.
entries.definitionCN: 使泄气。

entries.definition: To make something smaller in amount.
entries.definitionCN: 减少。

normalIntro.en: Deflate is de- plus flare, to blow: blow the air back out.
normalIntro.cn: deflate 就是 de- 加 flare（吹）：把气吹回去、放出来。

normal.en: Flare means to blow.
normal.cn: flare 意为吹。

normal.en: Inflate blows air in.
normal.cn: inflate 把气吹进去。

normal.en: De- blows the air out.
normal.cn: de- 把气吹出来。

normal.en: A deflated tyre goes flat.
normal.cn: 放了气的轮胎就瘪了。

normal.en: Bad news deflates a proud team.
normal.cn: 坏消息让骄傲的队伍泄气。

abstract.en: A tight skin loosening as the breath leaves.
abstract.cn: 气一走，绷紧的皮就松了。

abstract.en: A balloon of pride pricked by one fact.
abstract.cn: 一个骄傲的气球被一个事实戳破。

abstract.en: Air let out of a swollen market.
abstract.cn: 把膨胀市场里的气放掉。

examples.en: She deflated the airbed before packing it.
examples.cn: 她打包前把充气床的气放掉了。

examples.en: His rude reply deflated her enthusiasm.
examples.cn: 他无礼的回答让她热情大减。

examples.en: The bank raised rates to deflate demand.
examples.cn: 银行加息以紧缩需求。

dict_mnemonic.text: deflate 谐音「弟弗雷特」——不如记 de（去掉）＋ flate（吹，与 inflate 同根）＝把气吹掉，「放气、使泄气」。

root: 拉丁语 flare（吹）→ inflare（吹入）→ 英语 inflate（充气）→ deflate（放气）

sensesIntro.en: One loosening skin: a tyre, a team, a market and an argument.
sensesIntro.cn: 同一张松下来的皮：轮胎、队伍、市场与论点。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a tight balloon loosening as the breath hisses out
core.cn: 核心意象：鼓鼓的气球随着气嘶嘶外泄而松皱下去

branches.en: A tight skin loosening as the breath leaves.
branches.cn: 气一走，绷紧的皮就松了。

branches.en: A balloon of pride pricked by one fact.
branches.cn: 一个骄傲的气球被一个事实戳破。

branches.en: Air let out of a swollen market.
branches.cn: 把膨胀市场里的气放掉。

branches.en: A big shape made small by a pin.

latinIntro.en: Latin flare means to blow and pungere means to prick.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 flare 意为吹，pungere 意为刺。

definition_zh: 核糖核酸；传递遗传信息的核酸；核糖核酸类分子
definition_en: ribonucleic acid, a single-stranded nucleic acid that carries, translates or regulates genetic instructions
core_image: 实验室里一段单链从模板上被抄下，随后离开核区去组装蛋白
scene: 实验室里一段单链从模板上被抄下，随后离开核区去组装蛋白。 RNA copies a stretch of DNA and carries that message out of the nucleus.
sceneCN: 这里取第 1 个义项（核糖核酸分子）；句意为核糖核酸抄下一段脱氧核糖核酸，并把这条信息带出细胞核。

pos.zh: 名词缩写：核糖核酸；遗传信息的传递与调控分子

derivatives.zh: 由缩写加表示「酶」的词尾构成，义为「核糖核酸酶」
由表示「信使」的成分与缩写复合而成，义为「信使核糖核酸」
由表示「核糖体」的成分与缩写复合而成，义为「核糖体核糖核酸」
由表示「转运」的成分与缩写复合而成，义为「转运核糖核酸」
由缩写与「以……为基础」成分复合而成，义为「基于核糖核酸的」
由缩写与「结合」成分复合而成，义为「结合核糖核酸的」
由缩写与表示「干扰」的成分复合而成，义为「核糖核酸干扰」

senses.title: The single-stranded molecule
senses.definition: the nucleic acid built from ribose, phosphate and bases, usually single-stranded
senses.definitionCN: 指由核糖、磷酸与碱基构成、通常为单链的核酸
senses.example: RNA is usually single-stranded, unlike DNA.
senses.exampleCN: 核糖核酸通常是单链，与脱氧核糖核酸不同。
senses.why: The extra oxygen in its sugar is the only chemical difference, but it changes the molecule's behaviour.
senses.whyCN: 其糖上多出的一个氧原子是唯一的化学差别，却改变了分子的行为。

senses.title: Messenger RNA
senses.definition: the transcript copied from a gene and read by the ribosome
senses.definitionCN: 指从基因抄下、由核糖体阅读的转录本
senses.example: Messenger RNA carries the recipe from the gene to the ribosome.
senses.exampleCN: 信使核糖核酸把配方从基因送到核糖体。
senses.why: The molecule's main everyday role is to move a message, not to keep it.
senses.whyCN: 这个分子日常的主要角色是搬运信息，而不是保存信息。

senses.title: The machinery of translation
senses.titleCN: 翻译机器中的核糖核酸
senses.definition: ribosomal and transfer RNA that build proteins from the message
senses.definitionCN: 指按信息建造蛋白质的核糖体核糖核酸与转运核糖核酸
senses.example: Transfer RNA brings the matching amino acid to the ribosome.
senses.exampleCN: 转运核糖核酸把对应的氨基酸送到核糖体。
senses.why: Some RNA is not a message but a tool, part of the factory itself.
senses.whyCN: 有些核糖核酸不是信息，而是工具，是工厂本身的一部分。

senses.title: A viral genome
senses.definition: the genetic material of viruses that store their instructions as RNA
senses.definitionCN: 指以核糖核酸储存遗传指令的病毒所带的遗传物质
senses.example: The influenza virus stores its genome as RNA.
senses.exampleCN: 流感病毒以核糖核酸储存基因组。
senses.why: Viruses show that DNA is not the only possible archive.
senses.whyCN: 病毒说明脱氧核糖核酸并非唯一可能的档案。

senses.title: The RNA world hypothesis
senses.definition: the proposed early stage of life in which RNA both stored information and catalysed reactions
senses.definitionCN: 指生命早期阶段的一种假说，认为核糖核酸同时储存信息并催化反应
senses.example: The RNA world idea explains how catalysis and inheritance could start together.
senses.exampleCN: 核糖核酸世界的想法解释了催化与遗传如何同时起步。
senses.why: One molecule doing two jobs is simpler than two molecules doing one each.
senses.whyCN: 一个分子兼两职，比两个分子各司一职更简单。

senses.title: RNA interference and regulation
senses.definition: small RNAs that switch genes off or adjust how much product is made
senses.definitionCN: 指关闭基因或调节产物数量的小型核糖核酸
senses.example: RNA interference can silence a gene without changing its sequence.
senses.exampleCN: 核糖核酸干扰能在不改变序列的情况下关闭一个基因。
senses.why: The molecule is also a control signal, not merely a courier.
senses.whyCN: 这个分子也是控制信号，而不只是信差。

senses.title: RNA vaccines and therapeutics
senses.definition: medical products that deliver an RNA message so the body makes a protein itself
senses.definitionCN: 指递送核糖核酸信息、让身体自行制造蛋白质的医疗产品
senses.example: The RNA vaccine instructs cells to make a harmless viral protein.
senses.exampleCN: 核糖核酸疫苗指示细胞制造一种无害的病毒蛋白。
senses.why: If the body can read the message, the message can be the medicine.
senses.whyCN: 只要身体能读这条信息，信息本身就可以成为药物。

senses.title: The spelled-out chemical name
senses.definition: the full name ribonucleic acid, used when the abbreviation is defined
senses.definitionCN: 指解释缩写时使用的全称「核糖核酸」
senses.example: The glossary expands RNA on first use.
senses.exampleCN: 术语表在首次出现时展开核糖核酸的全称。
senses.why: Abbreviations need one clear expansion before they can travel.
senses.whyCN: 缩写需要先有一次清楚展开，才能通行。

intro.en: RNA abbreviates ribonucleic acid. Nucleic comes from Latin nucleus, a kernel; ribo refers to ribose, the sugar in the chain; acid comes from Latin acidus, sour. The initials became standard in the mid-twentieth century, and the exact first use is uncertain. The molecule differs from DNA by one oxygen atom in its sugar.
intro.cn: 这个缩写展开为「核糖核酸」：其中「核酸」出自拉丁语 nucleus「核、果核」，「核糖」指链中的糖，「酸」出自拉丁语 acidus「酸的」。首字母缩写在二十世纪中期成为通用写法，确切首见时间不确定。它与脱氧核糖核酸的差别在于糖上少了一个氧原子。

items.en: Nucleus meant a kernel, and the acid of the cell nucleus took its name.
items.cn: 这个词意为果核，细胞核中的那种酸便由此得名。

items.en: The phosphorus-rich acid isolated from cell nuclei was named after the nucleus.
items.cn: 从细胞核中分离出的富磷酸被按「核」命名。

items.en: The five-carbon sugar in the chain supplied the ribo- element.
items.cn: 链中的五碳糖提供了「核糖」这一成分。

items.en: The initials replaced the full chemical name as the molecule's roles became clear; the precise first use is uncertain.
items.cn: 随着分子的各种作用逐渐清楚，首字母缩写取代了化学全称；确切首见时间不确定。

items.en: The discovery of a short-lived transcript gave RNA a verb-like role: carrying a message.
items.cn: 短寿命转录本的发现赋予核糖核酸一个动词式的角色：传递信息。

items.en: The hypothesis that early life relied on RNA was named in the later twentieth century; the exact naming date is uncertain.
items.cn: 早期生命依赖核糖核酸的假说在二十世纪后期得名，确切命名年份不确定。

note.en: The first group shares the abbreviation shape; the second group names its types and the things it interacts with.
note.cn: 第一组共享缩写形式；第二组是它的类型与相互作用的对象。

entries.definition: Deoxyribonucleic acid, the double-stranded archive of inheritance.
entries.definitionCN: 脱氧核糖核酸，双链的遗传档案。

entries.definition: Messenger RNA, the transcript read by ribosomes.
entries.definitionCN: 信使核糖核酸，被核糖体阅读的转录本。

entries.definition: Ribosomal RNA, part of the protein-building factory.
entries.definitionCN: 核糖体核糖核酸，蛋白质工厂的组成部分。

entries.definition: Transfer RNA, which brings amino acids into place.
entries.definitionCN: 转运核糖核酸，把氨基酸送到位置。

entries.definition: An enzyme that breaks RNA down.
entries.definitionCN: 指分解核糖核酸的酶。

entries.definition: The RNA copy made from a gene.
entries.definitionCN: 指从基因抄出的核糖核酸副本。

entries.definition: The chemical family that includes both DNA and RNA.
entries.definitionCN: 指包括脱氧核糖核酸与核糖核酸的化学家族。

entries.definition: The particle that reads mRNA and builds protein.
entries.definitionCN: 指阅读信使核糖核酸并建造蛋白质的颗粒。

entries.definition: A three-base group that specifies one amino acid.
entries.definitionCN: 指规定一个氨基酸的三个碱基组合。

entries.definition: A particle that may carry its instructions as RNA.
entries.definitionCN: 指可能以核糖核酸携带遗传指令的颗粒。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations unpack the initials and the jobs the molecule does.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想把首字母展开，并记住这个分子承担的几项工作。

normal.en: Ribose plus nucleic plus acid: the sugar is the one with its oxygen kept.
normal.cn: 核糖加核酸加酸：这种糖保留着那个氧原子。

normal.en: DNA stores, RNA carries; the courier leaves the nucleus.
normal.cn: 脱氧核糖核酸储存，核糖核酸搬运；信差离开细胞核。

normal.en: mRNA is the message, tRNA the delivery, rRNA the factory floor.
normal.cn: 信使是信息，转运是送货，核糖体是车间地面。

normal.en: Some viruses keep their whole genome as RNA.
normal.cn: 有些病毒把整个基因组存成核糖核酸。

normal.en: An RNA vaccine gives the body a message instead of a product.
normal.cn: 核糖核酸疫苗给身体的是信息，而不是成品。

abstract.en: Storing and doing need not be separate jobs; early life may have used one molecule for both.
abstract.cn: 储存与执行不必分开，早期生命也许用一个分子兼做两事。

abstract.en: A message that can silence a gene is also a form of control.
abstract.cn: 能关闭基因的信息，也是一种控制方式。

abstract.en: The shortest-lived copy can be the most important one.
abstract.cn: 寿命最短的副本，可能是最重要的那一份。

examples.en: RNA is copied from DNA in a process called transcription.
examples.cn: 核糖核酸在称为转录的过程中从脱氧核糖核酸抄下。

examples.en: Some RNA molecules fold into shapes that catalyse reactions.
examples.cn: 有些核糖核酸分子折叠成能催化反应的形状。

examples.en: The test detects viral RNA in a sample.
examples.cn: 这项检测在样本中寻找病毒核糖核酸。

dict_mnemonic.text: 读作「阿尔恩埃」——比脱氧核糖核酸少一个氧，单链的「信差」：核糖核酸、传递遗传信息

root: 这是缩写，并非词根：全称由「核糖」「核酸」组合，其中「核酸」出自拉丁语 nucleus「核、果核」，「酸」出自拉丁语 acidus「酸的」；缩写于二十世纪中期通用，确切首见时间不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow the molecule from its chemistry to its messenger and machine roles, its viral use, its early-life hypothesis, its regulatory and medical uses, and its spelled-out name.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从化学分子出发，依次走向信使与机器角色、病毒用途、早期生命假说、调控与医疗用途，以及展开的全称。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a single strand copied from a template, leaving the nucleus to build a protein.
core.cn: 核心意象：一段单链从模板上被抄下，离开细胞核去建造蛋白质。

branches.en: THE NAME AND THE MOLECULE: the single strand, and the chemical name behind the initials.
branches.cn: 名称与分子：单链本身，以及首字母背后的化学全称。

branches.en: THE COURIER: a transcript carrying a gene's recipe.
branches.cn: 信差：携带基因配方的转录本。

branches.en: THE MACHINE AND THE VIRUS: RNA that builds protein, and viral genomes kept as RNA.
branches.cn: 机器与病毒：建造蛋白质的核糖核酸，以及以核糖核酸储存的病毒基因组。

branches.en: THE EARLY WORLD: a molecule that could both store and catalyse.
branches.cn: 早期世界：既能储存又能催化的分子。

branches.en: THE SWITCH AND THE DRUG: regulatory RNA, and RNA delivered as medicine.
branches.cn: 开关与药物：调控性核糖核酸，以及作为药物递送的核糖核酸。

intro.en: Like DNA, this word is an abbreviation whose parts come from chemistry rather than from old roots.
intro.cn: 与脱氧核糖核酸一样，这个词也是缩写，其部件来自化学命名而非古老词根。

latinIntro.en: Latin supplies the nucleus and the acid; the sugar and the initials belong to modern chemistry.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语提供「核」与「酸」；糖与首字母属于现代化学。

items.example: It gives nucleic, the acid of the nucleus.
It gives the final word of the full name.
The initials are read letter by letter.
items.exampleCN: 这三个字母逐字母读出。

items.example: It forms RNase, an enzyme that cuts RNA.
It forms RNAi, the silencing pathway.

derivatives.zh: 由缩写加酶名词尾构成，义为「核糖核酸酶」
由「信使」成分与缩写复合而成，义为「信使核糖核酸」
由「核糖体」成分与缩写复合而成，义为「核糖体核糖核酸」
由「转运」成分与缩写复合而成，义为「转运核糖核酸」
由缩写加「以……为基础」成分构成，义为「基于核糖核酸的」
由缩写加「结合」成分构成，义为「结合核糖核酸的」
由缩写加「干扰」成分构成，义为「核糖核酸干扰」

definition_zh: adj. 人为的；由人类活动造成的（尤指环境变化）
definition_en: Caused by human activity rather than by natural processes, especially of pollution, warming or landscape change.
core_image: 变化曲线在人类出现那一格突然抬头
scene: 报告把升温主要归因于人类排放。 Anthropogenic emissions drive most of the warming.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：报告区分自然因素与人类活动，anthropogenic 专指后者，即由人类排放造成的那部分升温。

pos.zh: 人为的；人类活动造成的

forms.label: 无 -er/-est 形式（多音节形容词，用 more/most）

senses.title: Caused by human activity
senses.definition: resulting from what people do rather than from natural processes, especially of emissions and warming
senses.definitionCN: 源自人的行为而非自然过程，尤指排放与升温
senses.example: The report separates natural from anthropogenic forcing.
senses.exampleCN: 报告把自然驱动与人为驱动分开。
senses.why: Greek anthropos means human and -genes means born of, so the word literally says born of humans, which is exactly the claim being made.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 anthropos 意为「人」，-genes 意为「由……而生」，所以这个词字面上说的就是「由人而生」，正是它要表达的判断。

senses.title: In wider earth science
senses.titleCN: 更广泛的地球科学用法
senses.definition: describing soils, landforms or deposits produced by human work rather than by nature
senses.definitionCN: 描述由人类劳作而非自然形成的土壤、地貌或沉积物
senses.example: The valley floor is an anthropogenic soil built by centuries of terracing.
senses.exampleCN: 谷底土壤是数百年梯田耕作形成的人为土。
senses.why: The same born-of-humans test is applied to physical features: if people made the layer, the layer is anthropogenic.
senses.whyCN: 同一条「由人而生」的判据也用于自然地貌：如果那一层是人造出来的，它就是人为的。

intro.en: Anthropogenic joins Greek anthropos, human, to -genes, born of, plus -ic. It was built in nineteenth-century science and became central to climate writing in the late twentieth.
intro.cn: anthropogenic 把希腊语 anthropos「人」与 -genes「由……而生」及 -ic 拼合。它造于 19 世纪的科学语境，20 世纪后期成为气候写作的核心词。

items.en: Greek anthropos meant a human being, and gives anthropology, anthropoid and misanthrope.
items.cn: 希腊语 anthropos 意为「人」，产生 anthropology、anthropoid 与 misanthrope。

items.en: Greek -genes meant born of or produced by, from the root gen-, to beget. It builds hydrogen, oxygen and carcinogenic.
items.cn: 希腊语 -genes 意为「由……而生、由……产生」，出自 gen-「生育」词根。它构成 hydrogen、oxygen 与 carcinogenic。

items.en: Nineteenth-century science joined the two pieces for origins caused by people, first in geology and physical anthropology.
items.cn: 19 世纪的科学把两个部件拼合，指由人造成的起源，最早用于地质学与体质人类学。

items.en: English added -ic to make the adjective, and the adverb anthropogenically followed for describing how a change was caused.
items.cn: 英语加 -ic 构成形容词，随后又出现副词 anthropogenically，用于描述变化是如何造成的。

items.en: Since the late twentieth century the word is standard in climate science, and Anthropocene names the proposed epoch of human dominance.
items.cn: 自 20 世纪后期起该词成为气候科学的标准用词，Anthropocene 则命名了以人类主导为特征的拟议地质世。

note.en: The look-alike group keeps the anthropos family and the -genic ending; the near-meaning group lists other words for made by people.
note.cn: 形近组保留 anthropos 词族与 -genic 词尾；近义组列出其他表示「由人造成」的词。

entries.definition: The study of human societies.
entries.definitionCN: 对人类社会的研究。

entries.definition: Resembling a human in form.
entries.definitionCN: 形态似人的。

entries.definition: The proposed epoch of human dominance.
entries.definitionCN: 以人类主导为特征的拟议地质世。

entries.definition: Causing cancer.
entries.definitionCN: 致癌的。

entries.definition: Made by people, not by nature.
entries.definitionCN: 由人制造而非自然形成的。

entries.definition: Produced by human skill rather than nature.
entries.definitionCN: 由人工技艺而非自然产生的。

entries.definition: Made by chemical combination.
entries.definitionCN: 通过化学合成制成的。

entries.definition: Brought about by an outside agent.
entries.definitionCN: 由外部因素引起的。

normalIntro.en: Anthropogenic is anthropos plus -genic: born of humans, so caused by us rather than by nature.
normalIntro.cn: anthropogenic 就是 anthropos 加 -genic：由人而生，所以是我们造成的，而不是自然造成的。

normal.en: The fixed phrase is anthropogenic climate change.
normal.cn: 固定搭配是 anthropogenic climate change。

normal.en: It contrasts with natural, not with artificial objects.
normal.cn: 它与 natural 相对，而不是与「人造物品」相对。

normal.en: The adverb is anthropogenically, as in anthropogenically warmed.
normal.cn: 副词是 anthropogenically，如 anthropogenically warmed。

normal.en: Carcinogenic shares -genic, so both mean produced by something.
normal.cn: carcinogenic 共用 -genic，所以两者都表示「由某物产生」。

normal.en: Do not confuse anthropogenic with anthropological, about the study of people.
normal.cn: 别把 anthropogenic 与 anthropological「关于人类研究的」混淆。

abstract.en: Picture a curve that jumps upward where people appear.
abstract.cn: 想象一条在人类出现处陡然上抬的曲线。

abstract.en: Imagine a soil layer made of centuries of terracing.
abstract.cn: 想象一层由数百年梯田耕作堆成的土壤。

abstract.en: Think of a fingerprint on a climate record.
abstract.cn: 想象气候记录上留下的一枚人类指纹。

examples.en: Most of the observed warming is anthropogenic.
examples.cn: 观测到的升温大部分是人为造成的。

examples.en: The lake suffers from anthropogenic nutrient loading.
examples.cn: 这座湖泊受到人为营养盐输入的困扰。

examples.en: Anthropogenic soils cover the old terraced slopes.
examples.cn: 人为土覆盖了旧日的梯田坡面。

dict_mnemonic.text: 拆件记忆：anthropo「人」+ genic「产生的」——由人产生的，就是人为的；气候报告里专指人类排放那一块。

root: 希腊语 anthropos「人」+ -genes「由……而生」加 -ic 构成 anthropogenic，字面即「由人而生的」，用于区分自然成因与人类活动成因。

sensesIntro.en: Both senses apply one test: was this born of humans? The answer labels emissions and warming, and also soils and landforms.
sensesIntro.cn: 两个义项都在用同一条判据：这是由人而生的吗？答案既标注排放与升温，也标注土壤与地貌。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a curve that lifts sharply at the human mark
core.cn: 核心意象：在人类那一格突然抬头的曲线

branches.en: Emissions traced to factories and farms.
branches.cn: 追溯到工厂与农场的排放。

branches.en: Warming separated from natural cycles.
branches.cn: 与自然周期区分开的升温。

branches.en: A soil built by centuries of terracing.
branches.cn: 数百年梯田耕作堆成的土壤。

branches.en: A landfill layer in a sediment core.
branches.cn: 沉积岩芯中的一层填埋物。

branches.en: Both pass the born-of-humans test.
branches.cn: 两者都通过「由人而生」这条判据。

intro.en: Anthropogenic is anthropos plus -gen plus -ic, and each piece builds a large scientific family.
intro.cn: anthropogenic 是 anthropos 加 -gen 加 -ic，每个部件都能撑起一个庞大的科学词族。

latinIntro.en: Both pieces are Greek: anthropos, human, and -genes, born of. Latin only supplied the -ic ending through French.
latinIntro.cn: 两个部件都是希腊语：anthropos「人」与 -genes「由……而生」。拉丁语只经法语提供了 -ic 词尾。

latinEntries.exampleCN: genes 构成 hydrogen 与 oxygen。

definition_zh: 地貌学；研究地表形态及其形成过程的学科
definition_en: the scientific study of landforms and the processes that shape them
core_image: 桌上摊开的等高线地形图旁边摆着岩层剖面与标尺
scene: 桌上摊开一张地形图，旁边摆着岩层剖面与标尺。 The course in geomorphology begins with river valleys.
sceneCN: 这里 geomorphology 指「研究地貌及其形成过程的学科」（第 1 个义项：以科学方法研究地表形态、成因与演化）；句意为这门地貌学课程从河谷讲起。图中可辨识物件：等高线图、岩层剖面、标尺、铅笔。

pos.zh: 地貌学（不可数）

senses.title: The science of landforms
senses.definition: the scientific discipline that studies surface forms and the processes that produce them
senses.definitionCN: 研究地表形态及其形成过程的科学学科
senses.example: The course in geomorphology begins with river valleys.
senses.exampleCN: 这门地貌学课程从河谷讲起。
senses.why: geo- 'earth', morphē 'form', -logia 'study': the word spells out 'the study of earth-forms'.
senses.whyCN: geo-「地球」、morphē「形状」、-logia「研究」：这个词把自己的含义写成了「研究地球形状」。

senses.title: A subfield named by its agent
senses.titleCN: 以作用营力命名的分支
senses.definition: a branch defined by its shaping agent, such as fluvial, glacial or coastal geomorphology
senses.definitionCN: 按塑造营力划分的分支，如河流、冰川或海岸地貌学
senses.example: Fluvial geomorphology explains the terraces above the river.
senses.exampleCN: 河流地貌学解释了河上方的阶地。
senses.why: once a discipline matures, it splits by the force it studies, and each split keeps the parent name.
senses.whyCN: 当一门学科成熟，会按所研究的作用力分支，每个分支都保留母名。

senses.title: The landforms of a region
senses.definition: the collection of surface forms and their history in a particular place
senses.definitionCN: 某一地点地表形态及其历史的总体
senses.example: The geomorphology of the basin records four ice ages.
senses.exampleCN: 这个盆地的地貌记录着四次冰期。
senses.why: speakers use the discipline's name for its object, saying 'the geomorphology of X' for the forms themselves.
senses.whyCN: 说话人用学科名代替其对象，用「某地的地貌学」来指那些形态本身。

senses.title: The developmental history of terrain
senses.definition: the sequence of events by which a landscape arrived at its present shape
senses.definitionCN: 一个景观形成现今形状的事件序列
senses.example: The valley's geomorphology includes two glacial advances.
senses.exampleCN: 这个河谷的地貌史包含两次冰川推进。
senses.why: the field's central question is not only what a shape is but how it came to be, so the word also names that story.
senses.whyCN: 这门学科的核心问题不只是形状是什么，还包括它如何形成，因此这个词也命名那段故事。

senses.title: Applied work on hazards and works
senses.definition: the use of the discipline in flood risk, slope stability, mining and road design
senses.definitionCN: 把该学科用于洪水风险、边坡稳定、采矿与道路设计
senses.example: Applied geomorphology mapped the landslide risk.
senses.exampleCN: 应用地貌学绘制了滑坡风险。
senses.why: when a science is hired to predict failure, it acquires an applied branch with its own name.
senses.whyCN: 当一门科学被雇来预测失稳，它就获得一个带自己名字的应用分支。

senses.title: Forms on other planets
senses.titleCN: 其他行星上的地貌研究
senses.definition: the extension of the discipline to the surfaces of moons and planets
senses.definitionCN: 把该学科延伸到卫星与行星表面
senses.example: Planetary geomorphology reads dunes on Titan.
senses.exampleCN: 行星地貌学解读土卫六上的沙丘。
senses.why: the same physics of wind, ice and gravity operates elsewhere, so the discipline travels.
senses.whyCN: 风、冰与重力的同一套物理规律在别处也运作，因此这门学科可以外推。

senses.title: A course or department label
senses.definition: the name of a taught subject or an academic unit in a geography or geology faculty
senses.definitionCN: 地理或地质院系中一门课程或一个学术单位的名称
senses.example: She teaches geomorphology on Thursdays.
senses.exampleCN: 她每周四讲授地貌学。
senses.why: a discipline also exists as a timetable slot and a departmental line, which is how most students meet the word.
senses.whyCN: 一门学科也作为课表格子与院系条目存在，多数学生正是这样遇见这个词。

senses.title: The study of any system's shape
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：任何系统形态的研究
senses.definition: the analysis of the shape and shaping forces of any system, not only terrain
senses.definitionCN: 对任何系统形态及其塑造力量的分析，不限于地形
senses.example: The lab applied geomorphology to the surface of a metal part.
senses.exampleCN: 实验室把地貌学方法用于一个金属零件的表面。
senses.why: the metaphor keeps only 'shape plus the forces that made it', so it fits markets, materials and organisations.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻只保留「形状加上造出它的力量」，因此适用于市场、材料与组织。

intro.en: Geomorphology joins Greek gē 'earth', morphē 'form' and -logia 'study'. The term was assembled in the nineteenth century from existing scientific vocabulary. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: geomorphology 把希腊 gē「地球」、morphē「形状」与 -logia「研究」组合起来。这个术语是 19 世纪用既有科学词汇拼装的。年代均为约数。

items.en: Gē meant 'earth, land, country'. It supplied the geo- combining form in geography, geology and geometry.
items.cn: gē 意为「大地、土地、国土」。它提供 geography、geology 与 geometry 中的 geo- 组合形式。

items.en: Morphē meant 'form, shape, appearance'. Its own origin is not established; proposed deeper links are hypotheses.
items.cn: morphē 意为「形状、外形、外观」。其自身来源未得到证明；提出的更深联系只是假说。

items.en: -Logia 'study of' comes from logos 'word, reason, account', the same element as in biology and geology.
items.cn: -logia「…研究」来自 logos「言词、理性、账目」，与 biology、geology 中的成分相同。

items.en: Morphology was formed in the late eighteenth and early nineteenth centuries for the study of form in biology and language.
items.cn: morphology 于 18 世纪末至 19 世纪初形成，用于生物学与语言学中的形态研究。

items.en: Geomorphology was assembled in the mid-nineteenth century when geologists needed a name for the study of surface forms.
items.cn: geomorphology 于 19 世纪中叶被拼装出来，当时地质学家需要一个名称来指地表形态研究。

items.en: Source uncertain (coiner and first date): the exact person and first printed use are disputed, and the deeper origin of morphē is unsettled.
items.cn: 来源不确定（造词者与首见年代）：确切的造词人与最早书证有争议，morphē 的更深来源也无定论。

note.en: Group one holds earth and form words that sound close to geomorphology; group two holds neighbouring disciplines and descriptors.
note.cn: 第一组是读音接近地貌学的地球与形状词；第二组是邻近学科与描述词。

entries.definition: The general study of form in organisms, words or materials; geomorphology restricts it to earth surfaces.
entries.definitionCN: 对生物、词语或材料形态的一般研究；geomorphology 将其限定于地表。

entries.definition: The study of rocks, minerals and earth history; geomorphology studies the surface shapes those materials make.
entries.definitionCN: 研究岩石、矿物与地球历史；geomorphology 研究这些材料形成的地表形态。

entries.definition: The description and mapping of elevation; geomorphology asks how those elevations came to be.
entries.definitionCN: 对海拔的描述与测绘；geomorphology 追问这些海拔如何形成。

entries.definition: The study of places, environments and spatial patterns; geomorphology is one physical branch of it.
entries.definitionCN: 研究地方、环境与空间格局；geomorphology 是其自然地理分支之一。

entries.definition: Of or produced by surface-shaping processes, as in a geomorphic feature.
entries.definitionCN: 属于或由地表塑造过程产生的，如地貌特征。

entries.definition: Relating to the discipline itself, as in geomorphological mapping.
entries.definitionCN: 与这门学科本身有关的，如地貌制图。

entries.definition: The study of the natural environment, of which geomorphology is one part alongside climate and hydrology.
entries.definitionCN: 研究自然环境，geomorphology 与气候学、水文学并列为其中一部分。

entries.definition: The broad group of disciplines about the planet, including geology, geomorphology and meteorology.
entries.definitionCN: 关于这颗行星的学科总称，包括地质学、地貌学与气象学。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real collocations and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实搭配与真实同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: geo- 'earth' + morphē 'form' + -logy 'study': the study of earth-forms.
normal.cn: geo-「地球」+ morphē「形状」+ -logy「研究」：研究地球的形状。

normal.en: The family runs geomorphology, geomorphologist, geomorphological, geomorphic, morphology.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 geomorphology、geomorphologist、geomorphological、geomorphic、morphology。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the branches: fluvial, glacial, coastal, planetary geomorphology.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出分支：河流、冰川、海岸、行星地貌学。

normal.en: Geology studies the rock; geomorphology studies the shape the rock makes.
normal.cn: 地质学研究岩石，地貌学研究岩石造出的形状。

normal.en: The parent form morphology names the study of form in biology and grammar too.
normal.cn: 母词 morphology 也指生物学与语法中的形态研究。

abstract.en: Picture a detective who reads a hill as evidence.
abstract.cn: 想象一位侦探，把一座山丘当作证据来读。

abstract.en: Picture a map and a rock section arguing about the same valley.
abstract.cn: 想象一张地图与一块岩层剖面为同一个河谷争论。

abstract.en: Picture a discipline that asks why the ground chose this shape.
abstract.cn: 想象一门学科，追问大地为何选了这种形状。

examples.en: Geomorphology explains why the river keeps shifting its bed.
examples.cn: 地貌学解释了这条河为何不断改变河床。

examples.en: She combined geomorphology with hydrology in her survey.
examples.cn: 她在调查中把地貌学与水文学结合起来。

examples.en: The paper reviews geomorphology in the drylands of central Asia.
examples.cn: 这篇论文综述了中亚旱区的地貌。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「geo（地球）+ morph（形状）+ ology（学科）」——研究地球形状的学问 → 地貌学

root: 希腊 gē「大地」+ morphē「形状」+ -logia「研究」（logos「理性、账目」）。morphology 先用于生物与语言形态，19 世纪中叶再拼出 geomorphology。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one field: the earth's surface is studied, its forces split the discipline into branches, a region's forms are named, their history is read, the work is applied, extended to other planets, taught in a timetable and finally borrowed for any system's shape.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一门学科展开：地表被研究、营力把学科分成分支、一个区域的形态被命名、其历史被解读、成果被应用、延伸到其他行星、出现在课表里，最后被借用于任何系统的形态。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a contour map lying beside a rock section and a ruler.
core.cn: 核心意象：等高线图与岩层剖面、标尺并排摊在桌上。

branches.en: DISCIPLINE AND OBJECT: the science studies forms, and its name is also used for a region's forms.
branches.cn: 学科与对象：这门科学研究形态，其名称也用于指一个区域的形态。

branches.en: BRANCHES: fluvial, glacial and coastal subfields split by the force they study.
branches.cn: 分支：河流、冰川与海岸子学科按所研究的营力划分。

branches.en: HISTORY: the central question is how the present shape came to be.
branches.cn: 历史：核心问题是现今形状如何形成。

branches.en: APPLIED AND PLANETARY: the discipline is hired for hazards and extended to other worlds.
branches.cn: 应用与行星：学科被用于灾害，也延伸到其他星球。

branches.en: COURSE AND METAPHOR: it appears on timetables, and its method is borrowed for any surface shape.
branches.cn: 课程与比喻：它出现在课表上，其方法也被借用于任何表面形态。

intro.en: Geomorphology is a three-element Greek compound. Each element still builds scientific vocabulary, so the word is readable as 'earth' plus 'form' plus 'study'.
intro.cn: geomorphology 是三个希腊成分构成的复合词。每个成分仍在构成科学词汇，因此这个词可读作「地球」加「形状」加「研究」。

latinIntro.en: Neo-Latin geologia, geographia and morphologia transmit these Greek elements to English science.
latinIntro.cn: 新拉丁 geologia、geographia 与 morphologia 把这些希腊成分传给英语科学。

items.structure: Greek gē 'earth' as a combining form
items.example: Geology and geography both begin here.
items.exampleCN: geology 与 geography 都从这里开始。

items.example: The first element names the planet.
items.exampleCN: 第一个成分命名这颗行星。

items.example: The middle element names what is studied.
items.exampleCN: 中间成分命名被研究的东西。

items.example: The last element makes it a discipline.
items.exampleCN: 最后一个成分使它成为一门学科。

items.example: Morphology studies form in many fields.
items.exampleCN: 形态学在许多领域研究形态。

items.example: A geomorphic process shapes the slope.
The course in geomorphology begins with river valleys.
items.exampleCN: 这门地貌学课程从河谷讲起。
一位地貌学家为阶地定了年。

definition_zh: 装饰；装饰品；装饰纹样；（音乐）装饰音
definition_en: the act or result of decorating something, or the decoration so added, including added notes in music
core_image: 一整面穹顶被金箔与刻纹铺满，抬头看时，屋顶不再是结构，而是一件穿戴整齐的华服
scene: 教堂穹顶下的工匠停下手中的刻刀，抬头端详刚完成的纹样， The ornamentation on the ceiling took three winters to finish.
sceneCN: 这里 ornamentation 指「被添加在建筑上的整片装饰」（第 2 个义项：装饰物整体）；句意为穹顶上的装饰纹样花了三个冬天才完成。图中可辨识物件：穹顶、刻刀、脚手架与金箔纹样。

pos.zh: 装饰；装饰品；（音乐）装饰音

derivatives.zh: 装饰华美的；辞藻华丽的

senses.title: The act of decorating
senses.titleCN: 装饰的行为；加以纹饰的过程
senses.definition: the act or process of adding decoration to an object, a building or a surface
senses.definitionCN: 为物件、建筑或表面添加装饰的行为或过程
senses.example: The ornamentation of the chapel ceiling went on for twenty years.
senses.exampleCN: 小教堂穹顶的装饰工程持续了二十年。
senses.why: The Latin suffix -atio formed nouns of action, so ornamentation first names the doing of the work rather than the things produced.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁后缀 -atio 构成表示动作的名词，因此 ornamentation 首先指「做装饰这件事」，而不是做出来的东西。

senses.title: Decoration considered as a whole
senses.titleCN: 装饰物的整体；成套装饰
senses.definition: the decorations that have been added, taken together as one body of work
senses.definitionCN: 已经添加的装饰，作为一个整体来看
senses.example: The gate's iron ornamentation is picked out in gold leaf.
senses.exampleCN: 大门的铁艺装饰用金箔勾出轮廓。
senses.why: Action nouns in English routinely shift to the result of the action, so the word can name the finished decoration rather than the labour.
senses.whyCN: 英语中的动作名词常从动作转向结果，所以这个词可以指完成的装饰，而非付出的劳动。

senses.title: Applied detail on a building
senses.titleCN: 建筑上的附加装饰细部
senses.definition: the carved, moulded or painted detail applied to a structure, as distinct from its supporting form
senses.definitionCN: 附加在建筑上的雕刻、线脚或彩绘细部，与承重结构相区别
senses.example: Dentils and rosettes make up the ornamentation of the cornice.
senses.exampleCN: 齿饰与圆花饰构成了檐口的装饰。
senses.why: Architecture separates what holds a building up from what dresses it, and ornamentation names the second category.
senses.whyCN: 建筑学把承重与装扮分开，ornamentation 指的正是后一类。

senses.title: Added notes in music
senses.definition: a note, trill or run added to a melody to decorate it without changing its main line
senses.definitionCN: 为使旋律更华美而添加的音、颤音或走句，不改变旋律主线
senses.example: Her ornamentation never blurred the shape of the tune.
senses.exampleCN: 她加的装饰音从未模糊旋律的轮廓。
senses.why: Music borrowed the visual logic of added decoration: the extra notes sit on the melody as carving sits on a wall.
senses.whyCN: 音乐借用了附加装饰的视觉逻辑：多出来的音覆在旋律上，正如雕饰覆在墙上。

senses.title: Painted decoration in a manuscript
senses.definition: the painted or gilded decoration placed around the text of a handwritten book
senses.definitionCN: 手抄本书籍文字周围绘上或贴金的装饰
senses.example: The psalter's margins carry dense ornamentation in blue and gold.
senses.exampleCN: 这本诗篇的页边布满蓝金两色的繁密装饰。
senses.why: Gold leaf and colour were laid around the writing rather than in it, the same added-surface pattern as on a wall.
senses.whyCN: 金箔与颜料铺在文字周围而非文字之内，与墙面装饰同属附加表面的模式。

senses.title: Density of decoration as a style
senses.titleCN: 作为风格的装饰繁简程度
senses.definition: the amount or density of decoration in a design, judged as a matter of taste or period
senses.definitionCN: 设计中装饰的数量或密度，作为品味或时代风格的判断依据
senses.example: The ornamentation of the later facade is far heavier than that of the nave.
senses.exampleCN: 后期立面的装饰远比中殿繁重。
senses.why: Once the noun can mean the total decoration, it can be measured, and a measurement of decoration turns into a description of style.
senses.whyCN: 当这个词能指装饰的总量，它就可以被计量，而装饰的计量便转化为对风格的描述。

senses.title: Display structures in animals
senses.titleCN: 动物用于展示的装饰性结构
senses.definition: in biology, a structure such as plumage, a crest or antlers whose main function is display
senses.definitionCN: 生物学中，以展示为主要功能的羽毛、冠饰或鹿角等结构
senses.example: The male's ornamentation includes a tail longer than its body.
senses.exampleCN: 这只雄鸟的装饰性结构包括一条比身体更长的尾羽。
senses.why: Biology extends the word to parts that an animal wears for show, keeping the idea of decoration while dropping the idea of craft.
senses.whyCN: 生物学把这个词扩展到动物为展示而穿戴的部位，保留了装饰观念，去掉了人工制作。

senses.title: Decorative language
senses.definition: the adding of ornamental words, images or detail to speech or writing
senses.definitionCN: 在言语或写作中添加华美词语、意象或细节
senses.example: Reviewers admired the essay's ornamentation but doubted its argument.
senses.exampleCN: 评论者欣赏这篇文章的辞藻，却对其论证表示怀疑。
senses.why: The transfer is from a decorated surface to a decorated sentence: both carry something added for beauty rather than for structure.
senses.whyCN: 转移发生在被装饰的表面与被装饰的句子之间：两者都带有为美感而非为结构添加的成分。

intro.en: Ornamentation is English ornament plus the Latin noun suffix -atio, which reached English through French -ation. Ornament itself goes back to Latin ornare 'to adorn'. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: ornamentation 是英语 ornament 加上拉丁名词后缀 -atio，该后缀经法语 -ation 进入英语。ornament 本身可追溯到拉丁 ornare「装饰」。年代均为约数。

items.en: Ornare meant 'to equip, fit out, adorn'. It covered both supplying gear and making something handsome, and English inherited the decorative side. Source uncertain: the deeper origin of ornare is not established, so any root proposed for it is a reconstruction rather than a witnessed form.
items.cn: ornare 意为「配备、装备、装饰」，既指供给器物，也指使某物美观，英语继承的是装饰的一面。来源不确定：ornare 更深的来源并无定论，凡为其提出的词根均属重构形式，而非实际书证。

items.en: Ornamentum, formed from ornare, named what was supplied: equipment, dress, and by extension decoration.
items.cn: ornamentum 由 ornare 构成，指被配备的东西：装备、衣饰，进而指装饰。

items.en: The suffix -atio, genitive -ationis, turned verbs into nouns of action and named a process rather than a thing.
items.cn: 后缀 -atio（属格 -ationis）把动词变为动作名词，命名的是过程而不是物件。

items.en: French carried the same suffix in the form -ation, and it was this French-shaped ending that English later took over.
items.cn: 法语以 -ation 的形式承继了同一后缀，英语后来接收的正是这个法语形态的词尾。

items.en: English borrowed ornament in the fifteenth century for an adornment and for the act of adorning.
items.cn: 英语在十五世纪借入 ornament，既指装饰物，也指装饰这一行为。

items.en: Ornament plus -ation produced ornamentation, first for the process and then for the finished decoration; the musical sense joined the word in the nineteenth century.
items.cn: ornament 加 -ation 构成 ornamentation，先指过程，再指完成的装饰；音乐义在十九世纪并入这个词。

note.en: The first group holds words that look or sound close to ornamentation but come from other roots or other parts of the same family; the second holds words for decoration that differ in scope or medium.
note.cn: 第一组是与 ornamentation 形近或音近、但词根不同或同族不同词性的词；第二组是表示装饰的词，在范围或媒介上有别。

entries.definition: The shorter noun and verb from which ornamentation is built; it names one piece of decoration rather than the whole scheme.
entries.definitionCN: 构成 ornamentation 的较短名词与动词，指单件装饰而非整套装饰方案。

entries.definition: The act of finding or setting a direction; it comes from Latin oriri 'to rise', not from ornare.
entries.definitionCN: 确定或调整方向的行为；来自拉丁 oriri「升起」，与 ornare 无关。

entries.definition: Richly decorated; it describes the style of an object, while ornamentation names the decoration itself.
entries.definitionCN: 装饰华美的；描述物体的风格，而 ornamentation 指装饰本身。

entries.definition: The general word for adorning anything, from a room to a cake; it carries no suggestion of a designed scheme.
entries.definitionCN: 为任何事物增添美观的通用词，从房间到蛋糕皆可，不暗示成套设计。

entries.definition: An added detail that improves a story, a design or a surface; it often implies something extra rather than structural.
entries.definitionCN: 为故事、设计或表面增色的附加细节，常暗示额外而非结构性的成分。

entries.definition: Decoration attached to a person or object, often jewellery or dress; it keeps the sense of something put on.
entries.definitionCN: 附着于人或物的装饰，常指首饰或衣饰，保留「穿戴上去」的含义。

entries.definition: A showy added stroke, note or phrase; it is the single decorative gesture where ornamentation is the whole body of them.
entries.definitionCN: 花哨的附加笔画、音符或语句；它是一个装饰动作，而 ornamentation 指全部装饰的总和。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real Latin pieces, the real word family and the contexts in which the word actually appears.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的拉丁构件、真实的同族词，以及这个词实际出现的语境。

normal.en: Ornare 'to equip' plus -ation 'process' gives the fitting out of a surface with beauty.
normal.cn: ornare「配备」加表示过程的名词词尾，就是给表面配上一套美观。

normal.en: Explanation, decoration and celebration share the same -ation ending, all names of processes.
normal.cn: 「解释」「装饰」「庆祝」等词共享同一个表示过程的名词词尾。

normal.en: Ornamentation is what a building puts on, not what holds it up.
normal.cn: ornamentation 是建筑穿上的东西，不是撑起它的东西。

normal.en: In music the added notes are ornaments, so the word crosses from stone to sound.
normal.cn: 音乐里附加的音就是装饰，这个词因此从石头跨到声音。

normal.en: A page of gold leaf around the text is ornamentation in the strict sense.
normal.cn: 文字周围的一页金箔，正是严格意义上的装饰。

abstract.en: Picture a ceiling so covered in gold that the structure below it can only be guessed.
abstract.cn: 想象一片被金箔盖满的穹顶，下面的结构只能靠猜。

abstract.en: Picture a melody wearing jewellery it did not need but could not lose.
abstract.cn: 想象一段旋律戴着并不需要、却又摘不掉的珠宝。

abstract.en: Picture a building dressed for a festival that never ended.
abstract.cn: 想象一座为永不完结的节日盛装打扮的建筑。

examples.en: The restoration removed four layers of later ornamentation from the doorway.
examples.cn: 修复工作清除了门廊上后来添上的四层装饰。

examples.en: Critics complained that the ornamentation of the new hall overwhelmed its proportions.
examples.cn: 评论者抱怨新大厅的装饰压倒了它的比例。

examples.en: The composer wrote his own ornamentation for the slow movement.
examples.cn: 作曲家为慢乐章写了自己的装饰音。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 ornament 听成「哦，那门」——门前挂满花环彩带，一看就是装饰；再加 -ation，就成了「装饰这件事，或这一整套装饰」。ornare 本义是「配备」，装饰就是给表面配上一套行头。

root: 拉丁 ornare「配备、装饰」衍生名词 ornamentum「装备、装饰」，英语借入为 ornament；再加拉丁动作名词后缀 -atio（经法语 -ation），构成 ornamentation，指装饰的过程与结果。ornare 的更深来源无定论，相关词根属重构形式。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses start from the act of decorating, move to the decoration as a body, then to architectural detail, added musical notes, manuscript painting, density of style, animal display structures and finally decorative language.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从装饰这一行为出发，转到作为整体的装饰物，再到建筑细部、音乐附加音、手抄本彩绘、装饰繁简程度、动物展示结构，最后是语言上的修饰。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a surface already complete in function that is then covered with something added purely for beauty.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个功能上已经完整的表面，又被覆上一层纯粹为美观而添加的东西。

branches.en: THE ACT ITSELF: the suffix names a process, so the word begins as the work of decorating rather than as any object.
branches.cn: 行为本身：后缀命名的是过程，所以这个词起初指装饰这项工作，而不是任何物件。

branches.en: THE DECORATION AS A BODY: once finished, the added material can be seen as one scheme, first in general and then as the applied detail of a building.
branches.cn: 作为整体的装饰：完成之后，添加的材料可以看作一套方案，先是一般装饰，再是建筑上的附加细部。

branches.en: DECORATION IN OTHER MEDIA: the same added layer appears as extra notes on a melody and as paint and gold around the text of a book.
branches.cn: 其他媒介中的装饰：同一层附加物出现在旋律上的额外音符，也出现在书页文字周围的颜料与金箔。

branches.en: MEASURE AND DISPLAY: decoration can be counted as a style, and living things can wear structures whose only work is display.
branches.cn: 计量与展示：装饰可以被计量为一种风格，生物也可以穿戴只用于展示的结构。

branches.en: FROM SURFACE TO SENTENCE: the last step moves the idea from a decorated object to decorated speech, where words are added for beauty.
branches.cn: 从表面到句子：最后一步把观念从被装饰的物件移到被装饰的言语，那里添加的是为美感而设的词。

intro.en: Ornamentation can be read as a base noun, a Latin verb behind it, and a suffix that names a process.
intro.cn: ornamentation 可以读作一个基础名词、其背后的拉丁动词，以及一个命名过程的后缀。

latinIntro.en: Latin ornare 'to adorn' gives the noun ornamentum; the action suffix -atio, reshaped in French as -ation, lets English build ornamentation on the borrowed noun.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 ornare「装饰」衍生名词 ornamentum；动作后缀 -atio 在法语中变形为 -ation，使英语能在借入的名词上构成 ornamentation。

items.structure: ornare, orno, ornavi (Latin verb, first conjugation)
items.example: The verb supplies the core meaning of making something handsomely furnished.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词提供了「使某物装点齐备」的核心含义。

items.meaning: means or result of an action
items.example: The suffix turns the act of adorning into the thing that is supplied.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把装饰的动作转为被配备出来的东西。

items.example: Latin used the noun for gear as well as for finery.
items.exampleCN: 拉丁语用这个名词既指装备，也指华饰。

items.meaning: the act or process of doing
items.example: The suffix names a process rather than a single object.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀命名的是过程，而不是单个物件。

items.example: French reshaped the ending before English borrowed it.
items.exampleCN: 法语先改造了这个词尾，英语随后借入。

items.structure: ornamentum, through French (English noun and verb)
items.example: English uses the short form for a single piece of decoration.
items.exampleCN: 英语用这个短形式指单件装饰。

items.meaning: the act or body of decoration
items.meaningCN: 装饰的行为或装饰整体
items.example: The long form names a whole scheme rather than one item.
items.exampleCN: 长形式指整套装饰，而非一件物品。

items.example: The suffix forms the adjective that describes decorated things.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀构成描述装饰之物的形容词。

derivatives.meaning: serving as decoration rather than structure
derivatives.meaningCN: 作装饰之用而非承重的

derivatives.structure: ornate + -ly (English adverb suffix from adjective ornate, Latin ornatus)

definition_en: relating to stomata, the small openings on a leaf surface
